Local changes on 2026-11-04:
In vendor/yaneuraou.k-p.js, change exactly one initial pthread-pool bound:
  Jb:function(){for(var a=0;32>a;++a)C.Qa()}
->Jb:function(){for(var a=0;2>a;++a)C.Qa()}
No modification to the WASM or worker.js. Original and local SHA-256 hashes
are recorded in ../engine-manifest.json. scripts/verify-engine-assets.cjs
verifies the loader modification and the upstream package integrity.

The candidate repository was archived in 2022. This old, third-party build is
being evaluated, not certified as the production engine. Package declarations
are the present basis for this PoC's license provenance; the final engine
release must include a complete, reproducible source/evaluation audit.

The new engine-lab adapter, UI and isolation scripts are GPL-3.0-only.
This notice does not change the license of the pre-existing application.
